card.fires_on: Words inside or just before anaphylaxis and epinephrine phrases, plus the word 'a' after 'sodium sulfite,' or 'sodium metabisulfite,' when introducing 'a sulfite that may cause allergic-type reactions'.

modes.label: Partway to anaphylaxis/epinephrine
modes.description: Words in instructions or text leading into anaphylaxis or epinephrine, such as 'an' in anaphylaxis, 'carry', 'administer'.
modes.example: Instruct patients to<< carry>> epinephrine with them at all

modes.label: 'a' after sulfite name
modes.description: The word 'a' after sodium sulfite or metabisulfite, leading into 'a sulfite that may cause allergic-type reactions'.

modes.label: Digits in epinephrine doses
modes.description: Zeros inside epinephrine concentrations or dose amounts.
